description: Redes de distribución eléctrica is a dataset listed in Argentine national open data portal (datos.gob.ar), an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaría de Energía. Redes de distribución provistas por el Consejo Federal de la Energía Eléctrica, empresas de distribución eléctrica provinciales y entes reguladores. Coverage: Argentina. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaría de Energía. Its tags are Consejo Federal, Distribución eléctrica, Información geográfica. It offers 53 resource(s) in CSV, SHP. The portal shows 2026-08-03 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ar-portal.
